fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-authored illustrated rulebook cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Page 1 of the cited publisher-authored rulebook, illustrated German rulebook front for the edition summarized in English. The image is labeled as a rulebook cover rather than a retail box. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

clarifications: The booklet does not define how the players should judge who is 'roundest.'
interpretation: Translated from the German instruction: Der 'rundeste' Spieler beginnt das Spiel.
internalEvidence: The Schmidt Spiele German booklet preserved by Brettspiele-Report identifies Reiner Knizia's Rondo for 2–4 players, matching BGG identity 129614. Its cover and printed/PDF page 2 were rendered and visually checked. Mirror PDF SHA-256: 32f7bacdb19ebf49ca36c42dc2cabbad18fee97e8e9f464174cf3ef28ee4a62f. This is an English summary of a German manual, not an English publisher edition. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The subjective 'roundest' criterion has no stated tie-break or fallback.
